raw.description:
Role reports to: Director Finance

Directly reporting to this role: N/A

Purpose

The Assistant Controller handles all accounting activities to support preparation of operating budgets and financial reporting. The insight that is provided to the business helps them to run a healthy and growing organization.

Activities and responsibilities

  • Timely implementation of monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements, including the associated reporting within the organization
  • Qualitative control of financial transactions within the accounting periods
  • Determination and booking of incidental business transactions, as well as the creation of provisions
  • Account reconciliation in the general ledger versus sub-ledger
  • Coordination and preparation of the annual financial statements with external partners/auditors/tax consultants
  • Work with HR on payroll related topics (including assistance with journal entries)
  • Determination of corporate taxes for the formation of provisions
  • Coordination and preparation of corporate tax returns with internal and external partners/tax advisors
  • Monitoring and preparation of periodic VAT returns and other reports
  • Active monitoring of the cash flow
  • Cross-departmental project work for process optimization
  • Be the contact person for local audit and tax consultants
  • Business partner for internal and external clients

Job requirements

  • Completed business studies with a focus on finance or relevant work experience
  • 3-4 years of practical experience in the field of financial accounting including knowledge in the field of controlling
  • Solid expertise in MS Excel and knowledge of MS Office, preferably knowledge of SAP,
  • Good planning and organisational skills
  • Independent and ability to work in a team
  • Flexible, resilient and result-oriented
  • Ability to achieve results in a fast-paced, changing, highly demanding environment
  • Good written and verbal communication skills (English and the country located)
  • Hands on attitude (from opening the mail to manage an audit)

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.

What you'll be doing

  • Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.

What you'll need

  • Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain— experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

Outcomes

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction


Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Philippines. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Philippines.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for applied AI engineers to build AI-native systems for BJAK's AI Finance Agent.

This is not a research-only role. We need builders who can use AI to automate real workflows, improve products, reduce manual work and make financial services easier for users and teams.

What You'll Own

  • Build AI-powered workflows, assistants, agents and automation systems.

  • Apply AI across customer support, CRM, onboarding, claims, renewals, payments, operations and internal tools.

  • Work with product and engineering teams to turn manual processes into scalable AI-native systems.

  • Build integrations with LLMs, internal data, APIs, documents, knowledge bases and business systems.

  • Design evaluation, monitoring and fallback flows so AI outputs are useful, safe and reliable.

  • Prototype quickly, test with users or operators, then productionize what works.

  • Improve speed, quality and consistency across workflows using AI where it creates real business value.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering foundation, preferably with Python and backend systems.

  • Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs, agents, RAG, workflow automation or AI tools.

  • Able to connect AI systems with real product, data and operational workflows.

  • Good judgement on where AI helps and where rule-based systems or human review are better.

  • Understands evaluation, accuracy, latency, cost, privacy and failure modes.

  • Fast builder who can prototype, test and ship practical systems.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, support automation, CRM or operations automation is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Practical AI builder, not just a prompt experimenter.

  • Thinks in workflows, systems and measurable quality.

  • Can build quickly but still cares about guardrails and reliability.

  • Comfortable working with messy real-world data and processes.

  • Honest about what AI can and cannot do.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want research projects with no production ownership.

  • Candidates who treat AI as demos instead of working systems.

  • Engineers who do not care about evaluation, reliability or user impact.

  • People who overclaim AI impact without evidence.

  • Builders who cannot work with product, ops and business teams.

raw.description:
Sobre a Clicksign

Somos uma empresa brasileira líder em assinaturas eletrônicas. Em essência, facilitamos relações entre pessoas e empresas no ambiente digital. Por trás da nossa tecnologia de ponta e foco em segurança, temos a missão de fazer o mundo crescer, tornando as relações digitais cada vez mais inteligentes.

Como trabalhamos:

Nossa essência é o Trust. Trabalhamos com foco, ritmo, comunicação clara e dados para nos apoiar. Trabalhamos com capricho; colocamos cuidado e qualidade em tudo que fazemos. Empatia e respeito são pilares da nossa equipe.

Descrição da Vaga:

Você fará parte dotime de RevOpscom foco direto no ecossistema deCanais e Parceriasda Clicksign. O objetivo principal da área é escalar a receita indireta e transformar a jornada dos nossos parceiros em um processo ultraeficiente, automatizado e orientado a dados. Buscamos uma pessoa com perfilBuilder / Low-Coder, que tenha paixão por resolver problemas de negócios desenhando arquiteturas técnicas inteligentes. Se você gosta de abrir documentações de APIs, criar agentes de IA, manipular bancos de dados e construir ferramentas internas customizadas (MVPs) que automatizam processos complexos de ponta a ponta, seu lugar é aqui.

  • Desenvolvimento Interno & MVPs:Projetar, construir e manter ferramentas internas, aplicações de apoio e MVPs focados em otimizar a experiência do parceiro (onboarding, enablement e gestão de carteira).
  • Engenharia de Automações:Criar, monitorar e evoluir fluxos automatizados complexos (usando n8n, Make ou similares) para registro de oportunidades, roteamento de leads, atribuição de deals e governança do canal.
  • Arquitetura de Comissionamento:Desenvolver e gerenciar a lógica técnica, motores de cálculo e automações para o processamento e acompanhamento de comissões de parceiros.
  • Integrações de Sistemas:Garantir que o stack de ferramentas de Parcerias converse perfeitamente com o CRM (HubSpot), sistemas internos e plataformas de dados via APIs REST e Webhooks.
  • Playbooks & Governança:Traduzir regras de negócio complexas em processos técnicos estruturados, documentando fluxos de dados e arquiteturas para garantir a manutenibilidade do ecossistema.
  • Cultura de Experimentos:Apoiar iniciativas de Growth, co-marketing e retenção de parceiros através da implementação técnica de experimentos multicanal e trackeamento de dados.
  • Perfil Low-Code Avançado:Experiência prática profunda na construção de fluxos e rotinas de integração utilizando ferramentas como n8n e similares.
  • Desenvolvimento de Agentes/IA:Vivência ou forte interesse prático na criação de agentes de IA e automações inteligentes (ex: Flowise ou frameworks similares).
  • APIs & Webhooks:Domínio absoluto no consumo, leitura e interpretação de documentações de APIs REST e manipulação de Webhooks.
  • Dados & SQL:Bons conhecimentos em bancos de dados, modelagem de dados e uso prático de SQL para consultas e apoio à tomada de decisão.
  • Operações & CRM:Experiência prévia em operações (Partner Ops, Sales Ops ou RevOps) em empresas SaaS ou tecnologia B2B, com forte domínio técnico de HubSpot ou CRMs de mercado.
  • Mindset de Produto/Engenharia:Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio de stakeholders não técnicos em soluções de software funcionais e escaláveis baseadas em low-code.

Diferenciais:

  • Vibing Code:Conhecimento em linguagens de programação (JavaScript e/ou Python) para desenvolvimento de scripts personalizados, manipulação avançada de JSONs ou customizações pontuais dentro do n8n/Make.
  • Stack de Dados & Eventos:Experiência com CDPs (Customer Data Platforms) e ferramentas de tracking/modelagem de eventos no ciclo de vida do cliente (ex: PostHog, Segment, Heap).

Habilidades comportamentais:

  • Autonomia e Propriedade:Perfil proativo que assume a demanda do início ao fim (da arquitetura à entrega do MVP).
  • Resolução Prática de Problemas:Curiosidade técnica refinada para testar hipóteses, depurar erros de integração e propor caminhos alternativos.
  • Comunicação Didática:Habilidade para atuar como ponte entre as necessidades do time de Negócios (Parcerias) e a realidade técnica dos times de Produto e Engenharia.

Informações adicionais

O que você pode esperar da gente?

﻿

  • Trabalho 100% remoto.
  • Cultura de confiança, focada em resultados e com muito desafio e aprendizado.
  • Autonomia e protagonismo, em um ambiente cheio de colaboração e empatia.
  • Cultura de feedback e 1:1 com uma liderança humana e sem microgerenciamento.
  • Benefícios completos como: vale refeição/alimentação, auxílios creche, home office, saúde, educação e cultura, gympass, day-off de aniversário, descontos em terapia e cursos de inglês, entre outras parcerias.

raw.description:
Tailored Brandsis a leading specialty retailer of menswear, including suits, formalwear, sportswear, and a broad selection of business casual offerings. Our brands include Men's Wearhouse, Jos. A. Bank, Moores and K&G Fashion Superstore, which offers merchandise for the entire family. We help people love the way they look and feel for their most important moments by delivering personalized products and services through our convenient network of stores and e-commerce sites.

About the Job

We currently have an exciting opportunity for a Sr Equity & Executive Compensation Analystto join our Compensation team. This role will support executive compensation programs, including incentive compensation, equity awards, executive benchmarking, trending analysis, and Compensation Committee materials. This individual will partner closely with HR, Legal, Finance, Payroll, executive leadership, external advisors, and the Compensation Committee’s independent consultant to deliver accurate, timely, and confidential executive compensation support.

What You’ll Do | Key Accountabilities

  • Support the design, analysis, and administration of executive compensation programs, including base salary, annual incentives, long-term incentives, equity awards, severance, change in control, and executive benefits.

  • Prepare executive-ready analyses, presentations, and materials for senior leadership, Compensation Committee, and Board-level discussions.
  • Partner with HR, Legal, Finance, Payroll, external consultants, and the Compensation Committee’s independent consultant to execute executive compensation programs accurately and timely.
  • Executive compensation governance trends, including shareholder expectations, regulatory developments, clawbacks, risk assessment, pay equity, and market best practices.
  • Support annual incentive and equity compensation processes, including modeling, payout calculations, grant planning, vesting, administration, and employee communications.
  • Maintain executive compensation data, documentation, approvals, and governance materials with a high degree of accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance.

What You’ll Bring | Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or similar field required
  • 8 years’ of progressive compensation experience, including equity and executive compensation
  • ECA or CEP Certifications preferred
  • Knowledge of:
o Executive compensation programs, including base salary, annual incentives, long-term incentives, equity compensation, severance, change in control, and executive benefits.
o Executive compensation benchmarking, including survey data, proxy data, peer group analysis, market positioning, and pay-for-performance practices.
o Incentive and equity compensation design, including performance measures, target setting, payout modeling, vesting schedules, grant practices, and plan administration.
o Employee Stock Purchase Plan design and administration, including eligibility, enrollment, purchase periods, contribution limits, discounts, and employee communications.
o Compensation Committee processes, including executive-level presentation materials, governance documentation, annual calendars, approvals, and decision support.
o Public company executive compensation disclosures, including proxy compensation tables, CD&A support, equity disclosures, and executive compensation data validation.
  • Strong analytical and financial modeling skills, with advanced Excel capability to interpret complex compensation, incentive, equity, and financial data.
  • Ability to prepare clear, polished materials for senior leadership, Compensation Committee, and Board-level discussions.
  • Strong business judgment, attention to detail, discretion, and problem-solving skills when working with highly sensitive executive compensation matters.

Work Environment, Physical & Mental Demands

  • Ability to sit and work at a computer keyboard for extended periods of time

Join the Tilt team

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.


The Opportunity: Credit Analyst, US Core

Tilt is looking for a Senior Credit Manager to support our Cash Advance business, one of our largest and most established product lines. You'll work at the intersection of credit policy, model development, and product strategy, helping us maintain the rigor and velocity of our existing credit programs while supporting a growing agenda of new product experimentation. This is an individual-contributor role with outsized visibility: you won't manage a team, but you will regularly partner with and influence senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders across the business.

This role is a great fit for someone who wants deep ownership of high-impact analytical work and who's energized by moving between rigorous quantitative analysis and creative, ambiguous conceptual problems.


How You'll Make an Impact

  • Sustain credit model and policy velocity: Support the ongoing development and refinement of credit models and underwriting policies for Cash Advance, helping maintain quality and pace as the program evolves.

  • Drive new product experimentation: Partner on the design and evaluation of new product constructs and pricing approaches, bringing rigorous credit analysis to test-and-learn initiatives that are still taking shape.

  • Bridge new product experiences and credit rigor: Bring both a user/product lens and a quantitative credit policy lens to new initiatives — helping ideas move from concept to tested, scalable strategy.

  • Communicate with precision and influence: Translate complex analysis into clear, decision-ready recommendations for senior stakeholders, and build the credibility to shape decisions without formal authority.

  • Partner cross-functionally: Work closely with data science, product, marketing and other credit and risk functions to keep initiatives moving and aligned with the broader business strategy.

  • Bring creativity and structure to ambiguous problems: Help scope and structure new analytical questions where the path isn't yet defined, and move initiatives forward with urgency and independent judgment.


Why You're a Great Fit

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Engineering, Business, Finance, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, or similar); advanced degree a plus.

  • 5-7 years of experience in credit risk, data analytics, or a related quantitative discipline, ideally in consumer lending or fintech.

  • Excellent communication skills — able to go deep in the analytical weeds and also distill findings clearly for an executive audience.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence outcomes and build trust with senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners without formal reporting authority.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving instincts, with comfort operating in ambiguity and a track record of driving projects forward independently.

  • A creative, action-oriented approach — someone who prototypes, tests, and iterates rather than waiting for a fully-defined brief.

  • Eagerness to learn new tools and methods, and to stay current with trends in credit, lending, and AI.

Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

What you'll get at Tilt

  • Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.

  • Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.

  • Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.

  • Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.

  • Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)

  • Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.

The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

Compensation Range: $170K - $200K

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.

What you'll be doing

  • Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.

What you'll need

  • Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain— experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

Outcomes

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction


Location

This role is based in Taiwan. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Taiwan office at least 3 days per week.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Employee Relations Partner – EMEA

Summary

The Employee Relations Partner – EMEA is a key contributor to the Employee Relations Center of Expertise (COE) team and the Human Resources function, supporting the company's mission and values. The Employee Relations Partner – EMEA is responsible for leading work environment investigations such as appropriate workplace conduct or relevant allegations, resolving Employee Relations issues, and providing guidance and coaching to HR teams and business leaders, in turn enabling people leader capability relative to various HR policies and practices.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and conduct end-to-end work environment investigations from intake to resolution, including case interviews, documentation review, fact-finding, analysis, and outcome resolution, for a region and group of Fortive Operating Companies, in a timely, thorough, and objective manner.
  • Prepare and deliver investigation reports, recommendations, and corrective actions to relevant stakeholders.
  • Partner with HR Business Partners, Legal (Compliance and Employment), and other internal teams to ensure adherence with regional, country, and local laws, as well as company policies and procedures.
  • Develop and implement Employee Relations processes, programs and policies to foster a positive and respectful work culture.
  • Provide coaching and guidance as a trusted advisor to HR teams, people leaders and employees on performance management, conflict resolution, feedback, and other positive Employee Relations topics.
  • Partner with other centralized HR functions such as Talent Enablement, Total Rewards, and People Operations, to provide a systemic approach to Employee Relations matters.
  • Utilize data to monitor and analyze Employee Relations trends and metrics and provide insights and solutions to Operating Company and Group leadership to proactively address root causes and prevent recurrence.
  • Design and deliver Employee Relations training and education to relevant stakeholders.
  • Due to the close proximity to work environment investigations, this Partner will have the unique ability to evaluate and lead regional opportunities and enterprise projects for relevant policy harmonization where appropriate and applicable.
  • May assist with organizational change initiatives where Employee Relations expertise is required.
  • Stay updated on best practices and emerging issues in Employee Relations and HR.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Progressive Human Resources experience and expertise in Employee Relations, with focus on conducting complex work environment investigations.
  • Demonstrated experience working with global organizations and strong knowledge of EMEA employment and labor laws across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and influencing skills, with the ability to build trust and rapport with diverse stakeholders.
  • Uncompromising ethics and high level of professionalism, integrity, and confidentiality, with the ability to handle sensitive and complex situations with discretion and sound judgment.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple cases, projects and priorities in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, with strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Proficient in HR and Case Management systems.
  • Professional Certification in HR or Employee Relations, such as CIPD, PHR, SPHR, SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, or CEI, is preferred.

Why You Should Join Us

  • You will make a meaningful impact by guiding our businesses in navigating complex workplace matters with fairness, empathy, consistency, and ethical decision-making.
  • You will have the opportunity to shape our workplace culture in creating and nurturing a positive work environment where employees feel valued, heard and supported.
  • You will closely partner with key stakeholders to identify and implement practical solutions that strengthen the Employee Experience and promote a respectful workplace.
  • You will join a trusted, highly cohesive and collaborative team that values sound judgment, encourages curiosity, and thrives on continuously learning from each other.

Fortive Corporation Overview

Fortive’s essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We’re a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.

At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.

At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.

At Fortive, we believe in growth. We’re honest about what’s working and what isn’t, and we never stop improving and innovating.

Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.

raw.description:
About Verto

At Verto, we're on a mission to democratise global finance and empower businesses in Emerging Markets to reach the world. Founded by British-Nigerian entrepreneurs Ola Oyetayo and Anthony Oduu, our roots in Africa provided a firsthand understanding of the significant challenges businesses face with cross-border payments, ranging from illiquid currencies and high fees to slow transactions. This deep-rooted insight is why Africa remains a core focus, as we're committed to bridging the gap between emerging and developed markets and fostering global economic growth.

What started as an FX solution for the Nigerian Naira has evolved into a market-leading platform, enabling thousands of businesses to seamlessly transfer billions of dollars annually. We believe that where you do business shouldn’t determine your success or ability to scale. We're creating equal access to the easy payment and liquidity solutions that are already a given in developed markets.

We're not alone in realising this crucial need; we're backed by world-class investors including Y-Combinator, Quona, and MEVP. With Verto receiving the Milken-Motsepe Prize, appearing on CNBCs list of fastest growing UK companies, the Deloitte Fast 50 and Sifted’s fastest-growing UK tech companies, we are building a seamless cross-border payment future.

Join us as we continue to grow and transform global finance.

Role Overview

We are seeking a talented and results-driven frontend expert to lead the architecture, development, and scaling of our web assets. In this role, you will bridge the gap between engineering, marketing, and cloud infrastructure, ensuring our corporate website delivers a flawless, high-performance user experience globally. You will own everything from headless CMS integrations to deep technical SEO and serverless cloud deployment. If you have a passion for pixel-perfect design, modern web paradigms, and deep technical ownership, this role is for you.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Architect, build, and maintain our corporate website to ensure a highly responsive, seamless, and pixel-perfect experience across all devices.

  • Work extensively with Contentful or similar headless CMS platforms to build dynamic, content-driven web pages that empower our marketing teams.

  • Implement advanced Server-Side Rendering (SSR) techniques and optimize Core Web Vitals to ensure lightning-fast performance.

  • Drive technical SEO improvements across our digital ecosystem to maximize global search visibility.

  • Build out and manage internationalization (i18n) workflows for multiple regions while ensuring strict adherence to web accessibility (a11y) standards.

  • Integrate, test, and manage marketing analytics tools, tag managers, and user-tracking scripts without compromising page load speeds.

  • Deploy and manage scalable web assets using AWS services, configuring DNS, CDN caching, and serverless functions to maintain high availability and low latency.

What You Need

  • Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in frontend web development or website engineering.

  • A strong, framework-agnostic foundation in modern JavaScript/TypeScript, DOM manipulation, and core web architecture.

  • Deep understanding of modern HTML5, CSS layout techniques (Flexbox, Grid, CSS variables), and mobile-first responsive design practices.

  • Proven experience successfully integrating headless CMS platforms such as Contentful, Sanity, or Strapi.

  • Practical execution of technical SEO strategies, web performance optimization (including minification, lazy loading, and image optimization), i18n, and web accessibility standards.

  • Solid, hands-on experience deploying and managing websites on AWS, including the configuration of S3, CloudFront, Lambda, Route53, and a working knowledge of basic networking.

Best If You Have

  • Strong, recent experience working with Angular architectures, specifically utilizing modern Angular paradigms and Server-Side Rendering (SSR).

  • Foundational backend experience with Node.js to build BFF (Backend for Frontend) layers, write API endpoints, or handle custom serverless logic.

  • Hands-on experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools like GitHub Actions or GitLab CI along with automated testing frameworks.

  • Experience in fintech industry or SaaS start-ups/scale-ups

About the Interview Process

It includes a chat with the talent team, a tech round with our principal architect, and a culture + tech chat with our Head of Tech


Life At Verto

Perks

  • Insurance paid by the company

  • Health and wellness benefits (with specific added benefits depending on the location of the role)

  • Yearly salary review based on inflation, personal and business performance

  • Access to entire Udemy’s library

  • Budget for professional development courses

  • Work-From-Anywhere policy for certain durations

  • Integration programme (opportunity to work from our global offices)

  • Regular team social events

  • Pension scheme (depending on the role location)

  • Flexible work arrangements

  • Exposure to work with globally distributed teams

  • Location specific benefits like car lease policy, cycle to work, gym membership, etc.

You’ll Fit Right In If You

  • Love asking “why?”

  • Value solving problems over just completing tasks

  • Understand sync vs. async communication practices

  • Thrive in ambiguity and change

  • Actively seek feedback

  • Prioritise impact over activity

  • Are fun to work with - we love good humour!

Culture

  • Our Core Values: These values reflect our focus, energy, and shared expectations.

    • Champion the Mission: We are driven by curiosity and belief to solve global cross-border payment challenges.

    • Be the Best: We are open, take calculated risks, focus on results, and excel in our work.

    • Work as One: We transparently share failures and successes.

    • Go the Extra Mile: We deliver beyond expectations and achieve the impossible.

    • Customer First: We creatively solve problems and boldly design better experiences for customers.

    • Run with It: We are determined, embrace challenges, own tasks, act swiftly, and deliver results.

  • Industry Competitive Compensation & Benefits: We reward employees for their value to the business with competitive compensation and benefits across all locations. This includes performance-based salary reviews, comprehensive health and wellness benefits, generous paid time off, and flexible working arrangements to support your career and life.

Diversity & Inclusion at Verto

Verto is an equal opportunities employer and we value diversity. Anyone seeking employment at Verto is considered based on Merit, Competence, Qualifications and their Talent. We are proud to be a truly international team and we do not discriminate in our hiring process.

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.

What you'll be doing

  • Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.

What you'll need

  • Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain— experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

Outcomes

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction


Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Vietnam. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Vietnam.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Bank, Moores and K&G Fashion Superstore, which offers merchandise for the entire family. We help people love the way they look and feel for their most important moments by delivering personalized products and services through our convenient network of stores and e-commerce sites.

About the Job

We currently have an exciting opportunity for a Sr Equity & Executive Compensation Analystto join our Compensation team. This role will support executive compensation programs, including incentive compensation, equity awards, executive benchmarking, trending analysis, and Compensation Committee materials. This individual will partner closely with HR, Legal, Finance, Payroll, executive leadership, external advisors, and the Compensation Committee’s independent consultant to deliver accurate, timely, and confidential executive compensation support.

What You’ll Do | Key Accountabilities

  • Support the design, analysis, and administration of executive compensation programs, including base salary, annual incentives, long-term incentives, equity awards, severance, change in control, and executive benefits.
  • Partner with the Compensation Committee’s independent consultant to conduct executive compensation benchmarking using survey data, proxy data, peer group analysis, and market trends to support executive pay plans and recommendations.
  • Prepare executive-ready analyses, presentations, and materials for senior leadership, Compensation Committee, and Board-level discussions.
  • Partner with HR, Legal, Finance, Payroll, external consultants, and the Compensation Committee’s independent consultant to execute executive compensation programs accurately and timely.
  • Executive compensation governance trends, including shareholder expectations, regulatory developments, clawbacks, risk assessment, pay equity, and market best practices.
  • Support annual incentive and equity compensation processes, including modeling, payout calculations, grant planning, vesting, administration, and employee communications.
  • Maintain executive compensation data, documentation, approvals, and governance materials with a high degree of accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance.

What You’ll Bring | Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or similar field required
  • 8 years’ of progressive compensation experience, including equity and executive compensation
  • ECA or CEP Certifications preferred
  • Knowledge of:
o Executive compensation programs, including base salary, annual incentives, long-term incentives, equity compensation, severance, change in control, and executive benefits.
o Executive compensation benchmarking, including survey data, proxy data, peer group analysis, market positioning, and pay-for-performance practices.
o Incentive and equity compensation design, including performance measures, target setting, payout modeling, vesting schedules, grant practices, and plan administration.
o Employee Stock Purchase Plan design and administration, including eligibility, enrollment, purchase periods, contribution limits, discounts, and employee communications.
o Compensation Committee processes, including executive-level presentation materials, governance documentation, annual calendars, approvals, and decision support.
o Public company executive compensation disclosures, including proxy compensation tables, CD&A support, equity disclosures, and executive compensation data validation.
  • Strong analytical and financial modeling skills, with advanced Excel capability to interpret complex compensation, incentive, equity, and financial data.
  • Ability to prepare clear, polished materials for senior leadership, Compensation Committee, and Board-level discussions.
  • Strong business judgment, attention to detail, discretion, and problem-solving skills when working with highly sensitive executive compensation matters.
  • Strong communication and cross-functional partnership skills, including experience with equity administration platforms, such as Morgan Stanley Shareworks or similar systems.
Please note that you do not need to qualify for all requirements to be considered. We encourage you to apply if you can meet most of the requirements and are comfortable opening a dialog to be considered.

Work Environment, Physical & Mental Demands

  • Ability to sit and work at a computer keyboard for extended periods of time
  • Must utilize visual acuity, speech and hearing, hand and eye coordination and manual dexterity necessary to operate a computer and office equipment
  • Hours regularly 40 hours per week, as work dictates, from a remote office location

Benefits

This role is eligible for healthcare including medical, dental and vision, retirement savings (401k with a company match), income protection programs such as life, accident and disability insurance, paid time off for sick leave, vacation, bereavement, jury duty, and holidays, wellbeing program, commuter, adoption assistance, education assistance, legal services, and employee merchandise discounts. raw.description:
Join the Tilt team

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.


The Opportunity: Credit Analyst, US Core

Tilt is looking for a Senior Credit Manager to support our Cash Advance business, one of our largest and most established product lines. You'll work at the intersection of credit policy, model development, and product strategy, helping us maintain the rigor and velocity of our existing credit programs while supporting a growing agenda of new product experimentation. This is an individual-contributor role with outsized visibility: you won't manage a team, but you will regularly partner with and influence senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders across the business.

This role is a great fit for someone who wants deep ownership of high-impact analytical work and who's energized by moving between rigorous quantitative analysis and creative, ambiguous conceptual problems.


How You'll Make an Impact

  • Sustain credit model and policy velocity: Support the ongoing development and refinement of credit models and underwriting policies for Cash Advance, helping maintain quality and pace as the program evolves.

  • Drive new product experimentation: Partner on the design and evaluation of new product constructs and pricing approaches, bringing rigorous credit analysis to test-and-learn initiatives that are still taking shape.

  • Bridge new product experiences and credit rigor: Bring both a user/product lens and a quantitative credit policy lens to new initiatives — helping ideas move from concept to tested, scalable strategy.

  • Communicate with precision and influence: Translate complex analysis into clear, decision-ready recommendations for senior stakeholders, and build the credibility to shape decisions without formal authority.

  • Partner cross-functionally: Work closely with data science, product, marketing and other credit and risk functions to keep initiatives moving and aligned with the broader business strategy.

  • Bring creativity and structure to ambiguous problems: Help scope and structure new analytical questions where the path isn't yet defined, and move initiatives forward with urgency and independent judgment.


Why You're a Great Fit

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Engineering, Business, Finance, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, or similar); advanced degree a plus.

  • 5-7 years of experience in credit risk, data analytics, or a related quantitative discipline, ideally in consumer lending or fintech.

  • Excellent communication skills — able to go deep in the analytical weeds and also distill findings clearly for an executive audience.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence outcomes and build trust with senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners without formal reporting authority.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving instincts, with comfort operating in ambiguity and a track record of driving projects forward independently.

  • A creative, action-oriented approach — someone who prototypes, tests, and iterates rather than waiting for a fully-defined brief.

  • Eagerness to learn new tools and methods, and to stay current with trends in credit, lending, and AI.

Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

What you'll get at Tilt

  • Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.

  • Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.

  • Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.

  • Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.

  • Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)

  • Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.

The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

Compensation Range: $170K - $200K

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.

What you'll be doing

  • Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.

What you'll need

  • Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain— experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

Outcomes

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction


Location

This role is based in Taiwan. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Taiwan office at least 3 days per week.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Employee Relations Partner – EMEA

Summary

The Employee Relations Partner – EMEA is a key contributor to the Employee Relations Center of Expertise (COE) team and the Human Resources function, supporting the company's mission and values. The Employee Relations Partner – EMEA is responsible for leading work environment investigations such as appropriate workplace conduct or relevant allegations, resolving Employee Relations issues, and providing guidance and coaching to HR teams and business leaders, in turn enabling people leader capability relative to various HR policies and practices.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and conduct end-to-end work environment investigations from intake to resolution, including case interviews, documentation review, fact-finding, analysis, and outcome resolution, for a region and group of Fortive Operating Companies, in a timely, thorough, and objective manner.
  • Prepare and deliver investigation reports, recommendations, and corrective actions to relevant stakeholders.
  • Partner with HR Business Partners, Legal (Compliance and Employment), and other internal teams to ensure adherence with regional, country, and local laws, as well as company policies and procedures.
  • Develop and implement Employee Relations processes, programs and policies to foster a positive and respectful work culture.
  • Provide coaching and guidance as a trusted advisor to HR teams, people leaders and employees on performance management, conflict resolution, feedback, and other positive Employee Relations topics.
  • Partner with other centralized HR functions such as Talent Enablement, Total Rewards, and People Operations, to provide a systemic approach to Employee Relations matters.
  • Utilize data to monitor and analyze Employee Relations trends and metrics and provide insights and solutions to Operating Company and Group leadership to proactively address root causes and prevent recurrence.
  • Design and deliver Employee Relations training and education to relevant stakeholders.
  • Due to the close proximity to work environment investigations, this Partner will have the unique ability to evaluate and lead regional opportunities and enterprise projects for relevant policy harmonization where appropriate and applicable.
  • May assist with organizational change initiatives where Employee Relations expertise is required.
  • Stay updated on best practices and emerging issues in Employee Relations and HR.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Progressive Human Resources experience and expertise in Employee Relations, with focus on conducting complex work environment investigations.
  • Demonstrated experience working with global organizations and strong knowledge of EMEA employment and labor laws across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and influencing skills, with the ability to build trust and rapport with diverse stakeholders.
  • Uncompromising ethics and high level of professionalism, integrity, and confidentiality, with the ability to handle sensitive and complex situations with discretion and sound judgment.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple cases, projects and priorities in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, with strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Proficient in HR and Case Management systems.
  • Professional Certification in HR or Employee Relations, such as CIPD, PHR, SPHR, SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, or CEI, is preferred.

Why You Should Join Us

  • You will make a meaningful impact by guiding our businesses in navigating complex workplace matters with fairness, empathy, consistency, and ethical decision-making.
  • You will have the opportunity to shape our workplace culture in creating and nurturing a positive work environment where employees feel valued, heard and supported.
  • You will closely partner with key stakeholders to identify and implement practical solutions that strengthen the Employee Experience and promote a respectful workplace.
  • You will join a trusted, highly cohesive and collaborative team that values sound judgment, encourages curiosity, and thrives on continuously learning from each other.

Fortive Corporation Overview

Fortive’s essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We’re a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.

At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.

At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.

At Fortive, we believe in growth. We’re honest about what’s working and what isn’t, and we never stop improving and innovating.

Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.

About Verto

At Verto, we're on a mission to democratise global finance and empower businesses in Emerging Markets to reach the world. Founded by British-Nigerian entrepreneurs Ola Oyetayo and Anthony Oduu, our roots in Africa provided a firsthand understanding of the significant challenges businesses face with cross-border payments, ranging from illiquid currencies and high fees to slow transactions. This deep-rooted insight is why Africa remains a core focus, as we're committed to bridging the gap between emerging and developed markets and fostering global economic growth.

What started as an FX solution for the Nigerian Naira has evolved into a market-leading platform, enabling thousands of businesses to seamlessly transfer billions of dollars annually. We believe that where you do business shouldn’t determine your success or ability to scale. We're creating equal access to the easy payment and liquidity solutions that are already a given in developed markets.

We're not alone in realising this crucial need; we're backed by world-class investors including Y-Combinator, Quona, and MEVP. With Verto receiving the Milken-Motsepe Prize, appearing on CNBCs list of fastest growing UK companies, the Deloitte Fast 50 and Sifted’s fastest-growing UK tech companies, we are building a seamless cross-border payment future.

Join us as we continue to grow and transform global finance.

Role Overview

We are seeking a talented and results-driven frontend expert to lead the architecture, development, and scaling of our web assets. In this role, you will bridge the gap between engineering, marketing, and cloud infrastructure, ensuring our corporate website delivers a flawless, high-performance user experience globally. You will own everything from headless CMS integrations to deep technical SEO and serverless cloud deployment. If you have a passion for pixel-perfect design, modern web paradigms, and deep technical ownership, this role is for you.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Architect, build, and maintain our corporate website to ensure a highly responsive, seamless, and pixel-perfect experience across all devices.

  • Work extensively with Contentful or similar headless CMS platforms to build dynamic, content-driven web pages that empower our marketing teams.

  • Implement advanced Server-Side Rendering (SSR) techniques and optimize Core Web Vitals to ensure lightning-fast performance.

  • Drive technical SEO improvements across our digital ecosystem to maximize global search visibility.

  • Build out and manage internationalization (i18n) workflows for multiple regions while ensuring strict adherence to web accessibility (a11y) standards.

  • Integrate, test, and manage marketing analytics tools, tag managers, and user-tracking scripts without compromising page load speeds.

  • Deploy and manage scalable web assets using AWS services, configuring DNS, CDN caching, and serverless functions to maintain high availability and low latency.

What You Need

  • Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in frontend web development or website engineering.

  • A strong, framework-agnostic foundation in modern JavaScript/TypeScript, DOM manipulation, and core web architecture.

  • Deep understanding of modern HTML5, CSS layout techniques (Flexbox, Grid, CSS variables), and mobile-first responsive design practices.

  • Proven experience successfully integrating headless CMS platforms such as Contentful, Sanity, or Strapi.

  • Practical execution of technical SEO strategies, web performance optimization (including minification, lazy loading, and image optimization), i18n, and web accessibility standards.

  • Solid, hands-on experience deploying and managing websites on AWS, including the configuration of S3, CloudFront, Lambda, Route53, and a working knowledge of basic networking.

Best If You Have

  • Strong, recent experience working with Angular architectures, specifically utilizing modern Angular paradigms and Server-Side Rendering (SSR).

  • Foundational backend experience with Node.js to build BFF (Backend for Frontend) layers, write API endpoints, or handle custom serverless logic.

  • Hands-on experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools like GitHub Actions or GitLab CI along with automated testing frameworks.

  • Experience in fintech industry or SaaS start-ups/scale-ups

About the Interview Process

It includes a chat with the talent team, a tech round with our principal architect, and a culture + tech chat with our Head of Tech


Life At Verto

You’ll Fit Right In If You

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.

What you'll be doing

  • Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.

What you'll need

  • Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain— experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

Outcomes

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction


Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Vietnam. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Vietnam.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
